sql_evidence.digest: SELECT o.order_id, d.detail_blob FROM t_order o JOIN t_order_detail d ON d.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = ? ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

top_sql.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, d.detail_blob FROM t_order o JOIN t_order_detail d ON d.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 1 AND o.created_at > '2026-09-01' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 1000
